name: devtools
description: The developer-machine toolchain in one plugin — mise (the .config/ three-file MISE_ENV split, tool/env placement, the file-based task library, the CI node-gpg workaround) plus /devtools:scaffold, Doppler for **development** secrets, Docker/OCI, and the repo-level quality gates the stack templates name: dprint, ESLint, gitleaks, grype, pre-commit. Owns the provider-neutral container-generic deploy template, so it also implements the vwf stack-adapter contract. Production secrets are a cloud plugin's, never this one's.
